fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kayle''' and the target allied champion are {{tip|heal|healed}} and gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds from the start of the cast time.
fields.leveling:
{{st|Heal|{{ap|55 to 155}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|24 to 40}}% {{as|(+ 8% per 100 AP)}}}}
fields.description2: If cast without a valid target, or [[self-targeted|self-cast]], ''Celestial Blessing'' will automatically target the closest allied champion in range, prioritizing the one with the lowest {{sti|{{as|health}}}}.
fields.description3: '''''Kayle''' can move during Celestial Blessing's cast time.''
fields.notes:
'''Details'''
* ''Celestial Blessing's'' cast time does not interrupt movement and the effects are applied at the start.
'''Interactions & Other'''
* If cast with [[Auto-targeted|auto-targeting]], ''Celestial Blessing'' may target allies who are {{tip|untargetable|untargetable}}, or allied clones that cannot be targeted by allies (such as {{cai|Warrior Trickster|Wukong}}).
